options: He studies hard to pass the exam.
He studies hard so as to pass the exam.
He studied so hard that he could pass the exam.
He studies hard in order to pass the exam.
He studies hard in order that he can pass the exam.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ③은 "so + 부사 + that"(결과 구문: 너무 열심히 공부해서 합격할 수 있었다)이며, 나머지는 모두 목적("합격하기 위해")을 나타냅니다.

options: I finished my job quickly so as to go home early.
I finished my job quickly to go home early.
I finished my job quickly so that I could go home early.
I finished my job quickly in order that I could go home early.
I finished my job quickly because I went home early.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 because(이유)를 나타내고, 나머지는 모두 "일찍 집에 가기 위해"라는 목적을 나타냅니다.

options: I hurried so that I would not be late. = I hurried so as not to be late.
She exercised to be healthy. = She exercised so that she could be healthy.
I tried hard so that I could pass. = I tried hard to pass.
Rachel studies hard so that she can get a prize. = Rachel studies hard so as to get a prize.
I left early to avoid the rush. = I left early, so I could avoid the rush.
questions.question: 다음 중 문장 전환이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤에서 콤마 + so는 결과를 나타내므로 목적의 to avoid와 의미가 달라집니다.

options: He saved money to buy a bike.
He saved money so as to buy a bike.
He saved money in order to buy a bike.
He saved money so that he could buy a bike.
He saved so much money that he couldn't buy a bike.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 "so much...that"(결과 구문: 돈을 너무 많이 모아서 자전거를 살 수 없었다)이며 의미가 다릅니다. 나머지는 모두 "자전거를 사기 위해"라는 목적입니다.

options: ② only
⑤ only
②④
②⑤
④⑤
questions.question:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

She turned on the TV to watch the news.

① She turned on the TV in order watch the news.
② She turned on the TV so as to watch the news.
③ She turned on the TV in order not to watch the news.
④ She turned on the TV so that she can watch the news.
⑤ She turned on the TV so that she could watch the news.
questions.explanation: ② so as to watch = 목적 표현으로 올바릅니다. ⑤ so that she could watch = 과거 시제 일치가 올바릅니다. ① in order 뒤 to 누락, ③ not이 붙어 반대 의미, ④ can은 turned(과거)와 시제 불일치입니다.

options: We'll do our best so that winning the game.
We'll do our best so that can win the game.
We'll do our best in order to we win the game.
We'll do our best in order to can win the game.
We'll do our best so that we can win the game.
questions.question:
다음 중 우리말을 영작한 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

"우리는 게임을 이기기 위해서 최선을 다할 것이다."
questions.explanation: so that + 주어(we) + 조동사(can) + 동사원형(win)이 올바릅니다.

options: I woke up early not to miss the bus.
I woke up early so that I wouldn't miss the bus.
I woke up so early that I didn't miss the bus.
I woke up early so as not to miss the bus.
I woke up early in order that I wouldn't miss the bus.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ③은 "so + 부사 + that"(결과 구문: 너무 일찍 일어나서 버스를 놓치지 않았다)이며, 나머지는 모두 목적("놓치지 않기 위해")을 나타냅니다.

options: He practiced hard so that he could learn difficult tricks.
He practiced hard in order that he could learn difficult tricks.
He practiced too hard to learn difficult tricks.
He practiced hard so as to learn difficult tricks.
He practiced hard to learn difficult tricks.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ③은 "too...to"(너무 ~해서 ...할 수 없다)로 부정적 결과를 나타냅니다. 나머지는 모두 "어려운 기술을 배우기 위해"라는 목적입니다.

options: ① only
⑤ only
①③
①⑤
③⑤
questions.question:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

We saved money <u>to take a vacation</u>.

① in order to take a long vacation.
② so as not to take a long vacation.
③ in order that to take a long vacation.
④ in order to we can take a long vacation.
⑤ in order that we could take a long vacation.
questions.explanation: ① in order to + V원형 = 목적 표현으로 올바릅니다. ⑤ in order that + 주어 + could = 목적절로 올바릅니다. ② not이 붙어 반대 의미, ③ in order that 뒤에 to가 불필요, ④ in order to 뒤에 주어+조동사 불가입니다.

options: He turned down the radio so that I could sleep. = He turned down the radio in order to sleep.
Jim turned on TV so that he could watch news. = Jim turned on TV in order to watch news.
He goes to bed early so that he can sleep. = He goes to bed early to sleep.
Brian practiced hard so that he could be a dancer. = Brian practiced hard so as to be a dancer.
I took my umbrella so that I could share it. = I took my umbrella so as to share it.
questions.question: 다음 중 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①에서 "so that I could sleep"(나의 목적)과 "in order to sleep"(그의 목적)은 주어가 달라 의미가 다릅니다.

options: (A) went
(D) invented
(E) talk
(B) wait
(C) could
questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A)~(E)에 들어갈 단어로 적절하지 않은 것은?

• Andy (A) _______ to bed early in order that he (B) _______ wake up early.
• Bell (D) _______ the telephone in order that we (C) _______ (E) _______ to others.
questions.explanation: (B) 위치에는 "could"와 같은 조동사가 와야 합니다. "wait"은 조동사가 아니므로 "he wait wake up"은 성립하지 않습니다.

options: I was nervous, so that I could hardly speak.
Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
She ran so that she could get there on time.
I jog every day so that I can stay healthy.
He drinks milk so that he can grow taller.
questions.question: [Part 3] 다음 중 밑줄 친 so that의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ①은 콤마 + so that으로 결과(긴장해서 말을 거의 못 했다)를 나타냅니다. ②~⑤는 모두 목적(~할 수 있도록)을 나타냅니다.

options: ③ only
⑤ only
③④
③⑤
④⑤
questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 영작한 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

"Sam은 그 기차를 놓치지 않기 위해 일찍 일어났다."

① Sam woke up early to not miss the train.
② Sam woke up early in order to miss the train.
③ Sam woke up early so as not to miss the train.
④ Sam woke up so early that he could not miss the train.
⑤ Sam woke up early so that he would not miss the train.
questions.explanation: ③ so as not to + V원형 = 올바른 부정 목적 표현입니다. ⑤ so that + would not = 올바른 목적절입니다. ① to not(비표준 어순), ② in order to miss(긍정=놓치려고), ④ so early that(결과 구문)입니다.

options: He took a taxi so that he wouldn't be late.
I gave him a knife so that he couldn't peel the fruit.
He tried his best so that he could win the contest.
This flower opens up so that it can get sunlight.
I turned off the TV so that my brother could study.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ②에서 칼을 줬는데 "couldn't peel"(과일을 깎을 수 없도록)은 의미상 어색합니다. "could peel"이 되어야 합니다.

options: Please move to one side so that we can all see.
Turn the fish carefully so as to it won't burn.
I drink coffee so that I can concentrate on my work.
He exercises every day in order that he can stay healthy.
Please speak louder so that all of us can hear you.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ② "so as to" 뒤에는 동사원형만 올 수 있으므로 "so as to it won't burn"은 틀립니다. "so that it won't burn"이 올바릅니다.

options: Watch out so as not to falling.
I study English so as to travel abroad.
I practiced hard so as to win the game.
I got up early so as not to miss the train.
I went to the market so as to buy some food.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르면?
questions.explanation: "so as not to" 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 합니다. "falling" → "fall"이 올바릅니다.

options: I listen to radio so that I can improve my skills.
He worked hard so that he could make money.
Please leave your number so that she can't call you.
We use public transport so that we can save energy.
Miran hurried so that she could see her friend.
questions.question: 다음 중 의미가 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③에서 전화번호를 남기는데 "can't call"(전화할 수 없도록)은 의미상 어색합니다. "can call"이 되어야 합니다.

options: Eunyoung set the alarm not in order to oversleep.
Many parents ask their children not to hang out with bad friends.
Take off your wet clothes so as to catch a cold.
Handong studied so hard in order to fail the test.
Nuri told lies so as to not hurt my feeling.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법 및 의미가 자연스러운 문장은?
questions.explanation: ② ask + 목적어 + not to V = 올바른 부정 부탁 표현입니다. ① not in order to → in order not to, ③ so as to catch a cold(감기 걸리려고?) → so as not to, ④ in order to fail(시험 떨어지려고?) → 의미 이상, ⑤ so as to not → so as not to.

options: She studied hard to get 'A' in English.
They work together for the championship.
I came early so that I could get a better seat.
I did the dishes so that my mom could get rest.
He ran to the bus stop in order to he could catch it.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: "in order to" 뒤에는 동사원형만 올 수 있으므로 "in order to he could catch"는 틀립니다.

options: ① only
② only
①②
①④
②④
questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

① I woke up early so that I will not be late.
② He was so wisdom that he was able to solve it.
③ I took a taxi so that I could get there on time.
④ I've saved money to buy a computer.
⑤ I took my umbrella for my mother.
questions.explanation: ① woke up(과거)인데 will(현재/미래) = 시제 불일치. would not이 와야 합니다. ② wisdom은 명사이므로 "so wisdom"은 틀립니다. "so wise"(형용사)가 올바릅니다.

options: Our teacher brought a DVD so that we could watch a movie.
Giho made cookies so that we could eat them.
Hajin took pictures so that we could remember the day.
Tom couldn't get in so that he had left his ticket.
We sang a song so that she would know we loved her.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 so that의 쓰임이 흐름상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④에서 "so that he had left his ticket"은 의미상 어색합니다. "들어갈 수 없었다"의 이유는 because이지 so that(목적)이 아닙니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) She is so wise that everyone respects her.
(B) He tried his best so that he can win the race.
(C) Speak too clearly that they can understand you.
(D) She was very careful so that she wouldn't drop the egg.
questions.explanation: (A) so + 형용사 + that = 결과 구문으로 올바릅니다. (D) so that + wouldn't = 목적절로 올바릅니다. (B) tried(과거) + can(현재) = 시제 불일치, (C) too → so가 되어야 합니다.
